entities.name: Renaissance Humanism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Intellectual movement (c. 1400–1600) emphasizing the study of classical Greek and Roman texts, the value of human reason and experience, and the potential for individual achievement. It drove the Renaissance and laid intellectual groundwork for the Reformation and Enlightenment.
